FIND OUT MORE Instructor Bios Meet the team behind the academy's hands-on coaching, chairside practice, and student-first classroom feel. RDA-OA Lead Instructor Jessica Jessica has worked in dentistry since 2015 and is a Roseville Dental Academy graduate. After completing the program and earning her x-ray license, she was hired at Waikiki Dental, grew through chairside, co-assisting, and patient administration roles, and discovered a passion for helping interns learn with confidence. Roseville Dental Academy alumna RDA since 2017 Orthodontic Assistant permit CPR/BLS instructor since 2019 RDA Assistant Instructor Sandra Sandra completed the academy in May 2022 and brings a student-centered perspective to the classroom. She enjoys sharing what she has learned, helping students grow through hands-on practice, and is continuing her own path toward dental hygiene. Roseville Dental Academy alumna Registered Dental Assistant Focused on student confidence Future dental hygienist RDAEF2 Instructor Sajal Sajal brings advanced dental training and a careful, compassionate teaching style to the academy. His approach combines technical precision, patient care habits, and mentorship so students can build dependable clinical skills. RDAEF2 instructor Advanced clinical training Mentorship-focused Patient-care oriented RDA Instructor Katelyn Katelyn attended Roseville Dental Academy in 2021 after moving from Indiana and has built her career around dental assisting and student support. She enjoys helping future dental assistants feel capable, prepared, and ready for the office.
